objects.name: Attack Flow
objects.description: Extends STIX 2.1 with features to create Attack Flows.

objects.name: Detection technique coverage: creation-of-shadow-copy
objects.description: The following analytic detects the creation of shadow copies using Vssadmin or Wmic. It leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on process execution logs that include command-line details. This activity is significant because creating shadow copies can be a precursor to ransomware attacks or data exfiltration, allowing attackers to bypass file locks and access sensitive data. If confirmed malicious, this behavior could enable attackers to maintain persistence,
